chips.label: Include provisional
chips.description: Also lists companies with a Provisional Prism rating (a rating built on limited history), each with its badge.

howItWorks: Only large caps: companies ranked 1 to 100 by market cap, as the site buckets them.
Only companies with a full Prism rating (Provisional ratings appear only with the Include provisional chip, with their badge).
Gates: Prism score 60 or more, Quality 50 or more, Risk 50 or more, long-term technical view above -20, no more than 30% below the 52-week high, and a 1-year return of 300% or less.

Ranked by a weighted score, 55% business and 45% price. Each input is the company's percentile among the rated companies of its size group: Prism score 40%, Valuation 7.5%, Risk 7.5%, long-term view 15%, short-term view 5%, momentum 15% (the momentum score of the Momentum leaders screen), and 52-week position 10% (100 minus the % below the high).
At most 3 companies from one Sector label. Ties go to the higher Quality, then the higher Prism score.
If fewer than 10 pass, the list is filled with the next names that fail only the trend or the 52-week gate, badged Trend not confirmed.
presets.disclaimer: A screen narrows a list. It is not a recommendation.

presets.name: Sector themes in play
presets.cardText: Sectors where more stocks sit near their 52-week high than in the market as a whole, and the companies leading them.

chips.label: Include small groups
chips.description: Also lists industries with 5 to 7 companies, which are too few to call a theme with the same confidence.

howItWorks: Every night each sector (by its Sector label) is scored on breadth, the share of its stocks within 15% of their 52-week high, and its median 3-month return against the whole market; stocks of Rs 1,000 Cr or more.
In play: breadth at least 40% and 15 points above the market's, and median 3-month return at least 5 points above the market's.

Leaders (up to 5 per sector): market cap Rs 1,000 Cr or more, within 15% of their 52-week high, 3-month return above the sector median; rated companies first by Prism score, then unrated by FinLit IQ.
Generic labels (Capital Goods, Financial Services, Services, FMCG, Healthcare, Information Technology) and groups under 8 companies are left out of theme status.
With fewer than 3 sectors in play, the 3 with the highest relative 3-month return among those with breadth above the market are shown as Closest to qualifying.
